name: ACT Ambulance fee waiver for concession cardholders
summary: Most Health Care Card holders aren't charged for ACT Ambulance services, which otherwise cost over $1,000 for emergency transport.
key: Most aged pension and health care concession card holders will be entitled to free of charge ambulances services.
who: Most Health Care Card and pension concession card holders
how: If you receive an ambulance account, send copies of both sides of your card to the address on the account.
catches: Emergency treatment and transport otherwise costs $1,180 plus $15 per km outside the ACT.

source.label: ACT ESA: Ambulance fees and charges
